function_question: How does nature share directions without words?

opening.text: There was a boy called Kofi who loved maps, puzzles and anything with a secret code.
Every term, Kofi and his best friend Sami teamed up for the school's treasure hunt in the nature garden, and every term they came close to winning.
On the morning of the hunt, Sami croaked a tiny whisper. He had laryngitis, and the doctor said: "No talking at all!"

card.problem: Kofi's teammate has lost his voice
card.goal: A code with no words that leads to the treasure

chapters.label: Chapter 1
chapters.title: A silent teammate
chapters.line: Kofi wonders: how can Sami and I share directions without words?

chapters.label: Chapter 2
chapters.title: Kofi needs a code maker
chapters.line: A silent hunt needs two clever code makers. Will you join Kofi?

chapters.label: Chapter 3
chapters.title: The nature heroes
chapters.line: You and Kofi meet heroes that send messages without a single word.

chapters.label: Chapter 4
chapters.title: The secret of the code
chapters.line: The heroes share why a code only works when everyone agrees on the rules.

chapters.label: Chapter 5
chapters.title: Silent signal practice
chapters.line: Kofi hides a toy and puts a finger to his lips.

chapters.label: Chapter 5½
chapters.title: The code storm
chapters.line: All 5 brainstorm rules help you invent loads of codes, then pick the best.

chapters.label: Chapter 6
chapters.title: The code key
chapters.line: Every great code starts as a key on paper.

chapters.label: Chapter 7
chapters.title: The big hunt
chapters.line: The first code sends Sami the wrong way. You fix it, and try again.

chapters.label: Chapter 8
chapters.title: Treasure found!
chapters.line: Kofi and Sami find the treasure first, without a word.

guide.brief: I'm Popi, your story guide. Kofi's teammate Sami has lost his voice on treasure-hunt day. Can you help them invent a code with no words? Let's start!
guide.your_idea: Some inventors already have a spark of an idea for a silent code. Do you?
guide.nature_clues: Nature has been sending secret messages for millions of years. Tap each card to meet four heroes who talk without words!
guide.design_secret: Here's the secret all four heroes share…
guide.skill: Scientists predict before they test. Which silent signal will get your partner closest to the hidden toy?
guide.sketch: Time to draw your code key, like a real code maker!
guide.build_and_test: Hide the treasure and guide your teammate with your code. How many steps away do they end up?
guide.retry_tip: Inventors never stop at round 1. Change ONE rule in your code and test again!
guide.ending: And ever since then, Kofi and Sami use YOUR silent code on every treasure hunt, and they've never been beaten.

quick_check.question: In Kofi's code, 1 clap means 5 steps. Sami claps 4 times. How many steps should Kofi take?
quick_check.right: Right! 4 claps times 5 steps is 20 steps.
quick_check.wrong: Not quite. Each clap is worth 5 steps, so try 4 times 5.

clue_cards.name: Honeybee
clue_cards.trick: A waggle dance in the hive.
clue_cards.does: The angle shows which way the flowers are, and the length shows how far.

clue_cards.name: Ant
clue_cards.trick: A scent trail on the ground.
clue_cards.does: Other ants follow the smell straight to the food.

clue_cards.name: Firefly
clue_cards.does: Only fireflies that know the pattern answer it.

clue_cards.name: Humpback whale
clue_cards.does: Whales in one area share the same song across many kilometres.

predict.prompt: Clear message or confusing? Predict first!

items.label: A secret wink nobody agreed on
A waggle dance for sister bees

predict.explain: A signal is only clear when the sender and the receiver both know what it means. A wink nobody agreed on could mean anything!

lab.predict: Which silent signal will get your partner closest to a hidden toy?
options: Drawing a map in the air

tool.name: Brainstorm
tool.intro: You already know all 5 brainstorm rules. Today you'll use every one of them to invent a whole storm of secret codes, then pick the best!

parts.name: Quantity
parts.example: 🥄 10 uses in 1 minute: drum stick, catapult, mirror, plant marker…
parts.starter: Another silent way to say "go left" could be…

parts.name: No Judging
parts.what: Every idea is allowed for now.
parts.example: 🥄 A spoon as a tiny boat? Write it down, no frowning!
parts.starter: Even if it sounds silly, I'll write down…

parts.name: Wild ideas
parts.what: Be brave and try something unusual.
parts.example: 🥄 A spoon that sings when you stir soup!

parts.name: Build on ideas
parts.what: Take an idea and add to it.
parts.example: 🥄 Spoon catapult → spoon catapult with a target.
parts.starter: Pointing could get even better if we added…

parts.name: Pick the best
parts.what: Choose the ideas that work best.
parts.example: 🥄 Keep the idea that's cheapest and most useful.
parts.starter: The best code for Kofi and Sami is… because…

sketch_checklist: I drew every signal in my code key.
I showed one signal for direction and one for distance.
I added a signal for "stop, you're here".

test.measure: steps away from the treasure your teammate ends up
test.check_question: Silent check: did you send the whole message without any words?

reflection.question: Which nature code helped you find the treasure?
